body_text: The road and infrastructure team at DMF has extensive experience in the region. Having worked on many of Dubai’s most prestigious projects with many major developers, our team has become the ‘go to’ team for roads and infrastructure design. Not only do our clients rely on our roads and infrastructure team to provide unique solutions, but even our colleagues and competitors. We proudly work along side many local architect and engineering firms to assist when needed. Our expertise is appreciated and the ability of our team to work with local municipalities is well known. From large to small engagements, our road and infrastructure group can provide all necessary services including: Infrastructure Master Planning Grading Design Roads Design Street Lighting Design Stormwater Drainage Design Sewerage Network Design and Lifting Stations Irrigation Main Line and Pumping Station Design Fire Hydrant Network and Pumping Station Design Potable Water Network Design Telecommunication Network Design LV Network Design
body_html:
The road and infrastructure team at DMF has extensive experience in the region. Having worked on many of Dubai’s most prestigious projects with many major developers, our team has become the ‘go to’ team for roads and infrastructure design.

Not only do our clients rely on our roads and infrastructure team to provide unique solutions, but even our colleagues and competitors. We proudly work along side many local architect and engineering firms to assist when needed. Our expertise is appreciated and the ability of our team to work with local municipalities is well known.

From large to small engagements, our road and infrastructure group can provide all necessary services including:

  • Infrastructure Master Planning
  • Grading Design
  • Roads Design
  • Street Lighting Design
  • Stormwater Drainage Design
  • Sewerage Network Design and Lifting Stations
  • Irrigation Main Line and Pumping Station Design
  • Fire Hydrant Network and Pumping Station
  • Design Potable Water Network
  • Design Telecommunication Network Design
  • LV Network Design
